objective: Route ordinary viewer chat, emotional/contextual conversation and important game analysis to bounded per-turn reasoning/output token budgets while using the same already configured Qwen checkpoint and preserving hidden-reasoning, latency, VRAM and TTS-clean output boundaries.
non_goals: Do not load, swap, download or retain a second text model or checkpoint.
Do not expose hidden reasoning, audience text, prompts or classifier internals through logs, memory, desktop, TTS or public status.
Do not open livestream adapters, M09 game control or M11 training in this slice.
contracts: Every text turn selects exactly one immutable budget before provider I/O: ordinary viewer chat uses either 0 reasoning plus 96 output tokens or bounded light reasoning up to 192 plus 128 output tokens; emotional/contextual turns use 256 plus 128; game analysis uses 384 plus 160 and only explicitly critical multi-step game analysis may use 512 plus 192.
All profiles call the same configured model name and preserve one checkpoint between private-reasoning and final-answer passes; the policy never selects another model tag.

Only the latest user message is classified. System prompt, memory, earlier viewer text, fresh vision evidence and hidden reasoning cannot promote a later simple viewer message into a more expensive profile.
Private reasoning remains absent from emitted tokens, logs, memory, desktop and TTS. A non-reasoning viewer turn keeps the preclosed-thought path.
The existing absolute provider deadline, context window, GPU-layer split, scheduler lease and model residency behavior remain unchanged.
allowed_dependencies: Python standard library and the existing text-brain provider/config/test stack.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests assert the exact Ollama num_predict values and request sequence for fast viewer, reflective viewer, emotional/contextual, game-analysis and critical-game examples.
Tests prove all five examples use the same configured model name, only reasoning profiles perform two generation passes, and no private reasoning is emitted.
A real local smoke exercises at least one emotional and one game-analysis turn on the current checkpoint and records latency without creating retained raw prompt/audio artifacts.
Text-brain fast tests and git diff check pass; GitNexus impact precedes symbol edits and detect_changes validates scope before commit.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M08-S21-adaptive-conversation-budget-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
